metadata.focus: Dataset filtering/sampling/construction/retrieval techniques for ML/LLM training

papers.title: A Survey of LLM x DATA
papers.description: Comprehensive survey covering bidirectional relationships between LLMs and data management. Covers DATA4LLM (deduplication, filtering, selection, domain mixing, synthetic augmentation) and LLM4DATA. Includes detailed taxonomy of data selection methods.

papers.title: A Survey on Data Selection for LLM Instruction Tuning
papers.description: Survey focused on data selection methods for LLM instruction tuning (SFT). Covers reproducible selection pipelines, pretrained selector models, and self-guided data selection.

papers.title: DataComp-LM (DCLM): In Search of the Next Generation of Training Sets for Language Models
papers.description: Testbed for controlled dataset experiments. Provides 240T tokens from Common Crawl, standardized pretraining recipes, and 53 evaluations. Demonstrates model-based filtering is key. DCLM-Baseline achieves 64% MMLU with 2.6T tokens.

papers.title: Ultra-FineWeb: Efficient Data Filtering and Verification for High-Quality LLM Training Data
papers.description: Efficient data verification strategy for rapid evaluation of data impact. Optimizes positive/negative sample selection for classifier training. Uses fastText classifier. Applied to FineWeb creating Ultra-FineWeb (~1T English, 120B Chinese tokens).

papers.title: MATES: Model-Aware Data Selection for Efficient Pretraining with Data Influence Models
papers.description: Data influence model continuously adapts to evolving data preferences during pretraining. Uses locally probed oracle data influence. Doubles gains over reference model selection and halves FLOPs. Open-source.

papers.title: QuRating: Selecting High-Quality Data for Training Language Models
papers.description: Captures human intuitions about data quality via four dimensions: writing style, required expertise, facts and trivia, educational value. Uses LLM pairwise judgments to train QuRater. Annotates 260B training corpus.

papers.title: RedPajama: An Open Dataset for Training Large Language Models
papers.description: Open dataset for LLM pretraining with wide range of quality filtering configurations. Demonstrates web-only data can achieve competitive results with proper curation.

papers.title: Programming Every Example: Lifting Pre-training Data Quality Like Experts at Scale
papers.description: Per-example quality programming for LLM pre-training. Evaluated on RedPajama-V2. Introduces heuristic baselines for FineWeb curation.

papers.title: Aleph-Alpha-GermanWeb: Model-based Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation
papers.description: German curation pipeline combining heuristic and model-based filtering with synthetic data generation. 628B-word dataset. Demonstrates model-based curation significantly enhances pre-training.

papers.title: The Evolution of LLM Adoption in Industry Data Curation Practices
papers.description: Studies how LLM adoption evolved in industry data curation workflows.

papers.title: Preserving LLM Capabilities Through Calibration Data Curation
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025 on curating calibration data to preserve LLM capabilities during scale-down.

papers.title: Escaping Collapse: The Strength of Weak Data for Large Language Model Training
papers.description: Formalizes curation needed for continual improvement with synthetic data. Uses boosting theory. Shows focusing on challenging examples improves performance.

papers.title: Predictive Data Selection: The Data that Predicts is the Data that Teaches (PRESELECT)
papers.description: PRESELECT method compared against DCLM and other baselines on C4. Uses data influence models (DsDm, MATES).

papers.title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Data Selection for Efficient Language Model Pretraining
papers.description: Multi-agent collaborative selection mechanism. Compares against QuRating, DSIR, MATES.

papers.title: Efficient Pretraining Data Selection via Multi-Actor Collaboration
papers.description: ACL 2025 multi-actor collaborative selection using MinHash deduplication and 10K clustering.

papers.title: Holistic Data Scheduler (HDS) for LLM Pre-training via Multi-Objective RL
papers.description: Online data mixing via RL (SAC). Multi-objective reward: data quality, inter-domain influence, weight norms. 44% fewer iterations, 7.2% MMLU improvement.

papers.title: Optimizing Pretraining Data Mixtures with LLM-Estimated Utility (UtiliMax)
papers.description: LLM-estimated utility for data mixing ratios. Compares against DoReMi and static approaches.

papers.title: BiMix: A Bivariate Data Mixing Law for Language Model Pretraining
papers.description: Systematic bivariate data mixing law for understanding and optimizing data mixtures in LLM pretraining.

papers.title: Topic Over Source: The Key to Effective Data Mixing for Language Models Pre-training
papers.description: Topic-based mixing outperforms source-based. Uses unsupervised clustering and LLM-based topic classification.

papers.title: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
papers.description: Diagnoses data mixture effectiveness using membership inference attacks.

papers.title: MixAtlas: Uncertainty-aware Data Mixture Optimization for Multimodal LLM Midtraining
papers.description: Extends data mixture optimization to multimodal midtraining with leverage scores and uncertainty awareness.

papers.title: A Coreset Selection of Coreset Selection Literature: Introduction and Recent Advances
papers.description: Comprehensive survey of coreset selection methods with taxonomy. Reviews sequential sample selection across ML fields.

papers.title: DeepCore: A Comprehensive Library for Coreset Selection in Deep Learning
papers.description: Comprehensive library implementing various coreset selection methods for deep learning.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Coreset Selection via Iterative Subspace Sampling (ZCore)
papers.description: Selects coresets without labels or training. Uses foundation model embeddings. On ImageNet at 10% data, 53.99% accuracy outperforms label-based methods.

papers.title: Moderate Coreset: A Universal Method of Data Selection for Real-world Deep Learning
papers.description: Moderate coreset using score median as proxy. Distance to class center as criterion. Universal method robust to scenario changes. Code: github.com/tmllab/Moderate-DS.

papers.title: Stable Coresets via Posterior Sampling
papers.description: Connects posterior sampling and loss landscapes for coreset selection. Smoothed loss function on model weights.

papers.title: Adaptive Dataset Quantization (ADQ)
papers.description: Dataset compression via adaptive quantization with representativeness, diversity, and importance scores. Superior generalization vs dataset distillation.

papers.title: Coreset Selection via Reducible Loss in Continual Learning
papers.description: Reducible loss (ReL) for coreset selection in continual learning. Forward computation only, more efficient than gradient methods.

papers.title: Active Learning for Data Streams: A Survey
papers.description: Survey of online active learning for data streams. Reviews pool-based and stream-based strategies.

papers.title: Active Learning with LLMs for Partially Observed and Cost-Aware Scenarios
papers.description: NeurIPS 2024 on LLMs for active learning with cost awareness. Uses EPIG method.

papers.title: Labeled TrustSet Guided: Batch Active Learning with Reinforcement Learning
papers.description: Batch active learning with balanced class distribution from labeled data. RL-based sampling. SOTA across 10 benchmarks.

papers.title: Most Influential Subset Selection: Challenges, Promises, and Beyond
papers.description: NeurIPS 2024 analyzing influence functions for subset selection. Discusses negative results and test point choice importance.

papers.title: Capturing the Temporal Dependence of Training Data Influence
papers.description: ICLR 2025 studying temporal dependence of data influence. Compares influence functions with data value embeddings (LoGRA).

papers.title: Do Influence Functions Work on Large Language Models
papers.description: EMNLP 2025 findings evaluating influence functions on LLMs. Studies transfer from traditional ML to LLMs.

papers.title: Training Data Influence Analysis and Estimation: A Survey
papers.description: Survey of influence analysis methods with formal definitions and research directions.

papers.title: Difficulty Is Not Enough: Curriculum Learning for LLMs Must Consider Utility (DUCL)
papers.description: AAAI 2025 proposing Difficulty-Utility Curriculum Learning. Shows difficulty-only ordering is insufficient.

papers.title: Does the Definition of Difficulty Matter? Scoring Functions for Curriculum Learning
papers.description: Investigates how different difficulty scoring functions affect curriculum learning.

papers.title: Harnessing Diversity for Important Data Selection in Pretraining LLMs
papers.description: ICLR 2025 proposing Quad: model-aware selection using data influence and diversity for pretraining.

papers.title: AttentionInfluence: Weak-to-Strong Pretraining Data Selection via Attention Heads
papers.description: Uses attention head influence for token-level data selection. Estimates impact via attention-based recall rates.

papers.title: Improving Pretraining Data Using Perplexity Correlations
papers.description: ICLR 2025 using perplexity correlations for data improvement. Compares against DCLM selectors.

papers.title: The Data-Quality Illusion: Rethinking Classifier-Based Quality Filtering for LLM Pretraining
papers.description: Challenges assumptions that classifier-based quality filtering always improves LLM pretraining. Critical analysis of quality classifiers.

papers.title: Lshbloom: Memory-efficient, Extreme-scale Document Deduplication
papers.description: Memory-efficient extreme-scale deduplication for LLM training datasets. Compares dedup methods for pre-training.

papers.title: MixMinMatch: Cross-Source Agreement for Multilingual Pretraining Datasets
papers.description: Cross-source agreement as free quality filter for multilingual data. MinHash dedup across corpora. Arabic 4.5% improvement over ArabicWeb24.

papers.title: Meta-Rater: Multi-dimensional Data Selection for Pre-training Language Models
papers.description: ACL 2025 multi-dimensional quality scoring with aggregation. Releases scripts, data, and models.

papers.title: Data Optimization for LLMs: A Survey
papers.description: Survey covering data defect methodologies and data utility improvement for LLM pretraining.

papers.title: Fixing It in Post: Comparative Study of LLM Post-training Data Quality
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025 benchmark comparing post-training dataset quality impact. Annotates and filters open-source SFT datasets.

papers.title: Automatic Instruction Data Selection via Uncertainty-Aware Influence Maximization
papers.description: Uncertainty-aware influence function for instruction data scoring. Emphasizes uncertain examples.

papers.title: A Survey on Efficient Large Language Model Training: Data-centric Perspectives
papers.description: ACL 2025 survey on data-centric efficient LLM training covering selection, filtering, and quality methods.

papers.title: How Text Quality Interventions Reshape Neural Scaling Laws for LLMs
papers.description: Shows data quality ranking is scale and resource-dependent. Analyzes synthetic vs natural data scaling.

papers.title: From Reweighting to Rewriting: Unlocking the Intervention Effects of Influential Samples in Training Data Attribution
papers.authors: Yuzhang Luo, Chenpeng Wang, Jianhui Chen, Liangming Pan
papers.description: Proposes influence-guided response rewriting as an alternative to reweighting for training data attribution (TDA). Shows that influence functions (IF) identify intervention targets more effectively when combined with response rewriting (replacing responses with behavior-aligned/opposed supervision) rather than conventional weight-based interventions. Across four open-weight LLMs, rewriting produces stronger, more persistent, and bidirectional behavioral shifts on epistemic abstention and safety refusal, while reweighting the same examples yields weak and inconsistent effects.

papers.title: Difficulty-Diversity Collaborative Filtering for Data-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning (DDCF)
papers.description: Proposes DDCF, a scalable and domain-agnostic data curation method for efficient LLM fine-tuning that jointly considers difficulty and diversity of training samples. Presented at ICLR 2026. Offers a principled approach to selecting high-quality training data by balancing sample difficulty with dataset diversity.
papers.note: Discovered via SearXNG; likely submitted before Sept 1 but not in baseline. Including as missed discovery from prior run.

papers.title: CPQS-Tuning: A Model Self-Perception-Based Data Filtering Algorithm for Efficient Instruction Fine-Tuning
papers.description: Proposes a model self-perception-based data filtering algorithm (CPQS-Tuning) that uses the LLM's own quality assessment of training data to filter instruction fine-tuning datasets. Addresses the challenge of low-quality and redundant data in instruction tuning by leveraging the model's internal signals for data selection.
papers.note: Discovered via SearXNG OpenReview search; not in baseline. May predate Sept 1 window but was not captured in prior runs.

papers.title: AlignDiff: Exploiting Model-Intrinsic Information for Better Preference Data Selection
papers.abstract: Aligning large language models with human preferences remains a challenge, primarily due to the critical role of preference data quality in effective alignment. Existing datasets are frequently plagued by inherent noise and distribution shifts, which inherently limit model performance. To bridge this gap, we propose AlignDiff, a preference data filtering framework driven by intrinsic model signals. AlignDiff first identifies samples with clear preferences using both positive and inverse signals, then prioritizes the more challenging samples based on the average negative log-likelihood gap, encouraging the model to learn richer information from them. AlignDiff is evaluated on two widely used model families (LLaMA and Qwen) and three benchmarks widely adopted in the alignment community (AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench). Across all settings, it consistently outperforms seven strong baselines.

papers.title: Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting. We propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states.

papers.title: Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora
papers.abstract: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe). With the FineMath classifier as the probe, 21.9% of crawled pages are high-quality math content, 70x the 0.31% rate from filtering a comparable web sample. 63.2% of these pages are missing from CommonCrawl altogether. Continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-3B on 1.9B Data Scout tokens matches FineMath corpus on GSM8k.

papers.title: RoboDrop: Curating VLA Post-Training Data via Local Gradient Compatibility
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models acquire broad generalization through large-scale pretraining, yet adapting them to a new task still requires post-training on newly collected data. Collected robot datasets often contain heterogeneous errors. We introduce RoboDrop, a data-curation framework that audits supervision using local gradient compatibility measured along the training trajectory. During a one-epoch warm-up run, RoboDrop scores each candidate sample online by comparing its gradient with those of task-semantic and visually matched validation samples. Post-training on the curated data consistently yields stronger downstream policies, with average real-robot rollout success rising from 35.0% to 67.5%.
key_methods: automatic filtering decisions from gradient signals

papers.title: Edu-QuRating: Multi-Dimensional Educational Data Curation with Distilled Pairwise Judgements
papers.abstract: Educational data filters have become a practical way to improve language-model pre-training, but most filters treat educational value as a single scalar property. Following QuRating, we introduce Edu-QuRating: a pipeline for multi-dimensional educational data scoring and curation. Edu-QuRating defines education-specific rubrics, uses an LLM judge to label sampled document pairs and distills those pairwise preferences into reusable Edu-QuRaters, which can score individual text chunks on a set of educational criteria. Across two sequence-classification base models and six educational criteria, the best Edu-QuRater recovers held-out GPT-4.1-mini pairwise judgements with mean accuracy 0.917. Models trained with Edu-QuRating-based mixtures reached higher observed aggregate accuracy across nine benchmarks than the FineWeb-Edu baseline.

papers.title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp). RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.
key_methods: contrastive ablation for attention head identification

papers.title: Rethinking Data Curation in LLM Training: Online Reweighting Offers Better Generalization than Offline Methods (ADAPT)
papers.abstract: Proposes ADAPT (Adaptive Data reweighting for Pretraining and FineTuning), a dynamic online framework that reweights training samples with adaptive per-sample learning rates guided by similarity-based quality signals. Unlike offline methods that enforce a static data distribution, ADAPT acts as an implicit curriculum learner. ICLR 2026.

papers.title: CuratorKIT: Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: Open-source Python library covering the full data curation lifecycle in a single configurable pipeline: ingestion, deduplication, synthetic generation, quality filtering with provenance-exact hallucination verification, structured adaptive recovery, and five training-ready export formats (TRL, Unsloth, AlignTune). Every pipeline decision is recorded in an append-only per-sample provenance chain.

papers.title: Provenance-Grounded Gating and Adaptive Recovery in Synthetic Post-Training Data Curation
papers.abstract: Controlled study of provenance-grounded filtering and adaptive recovery of rejected samples in synthetic post-training pipelines. Finds that exact source provenance improves faithfulness gating, hallucination and reward gates reject largely disjoint populations, and adaptive recovery achieves higher yield than naive resampling.

papers.title: DataChef-32B: Cooking Up Optimal Data Recipes for LLM Adaptation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Formulates end-to-end data recipe generation for LLM adaptation. DataChef-32B performs online RL using a proxy reward predicting downstream performance. Adapts Qwen3-1.7B-Base to math domain achieving 66.7 on AIME'25, surpassing the official post-training checkpoint.

papers.title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Scalable inference-only data valuation pipeline approximating Shapley values without iterative retraining. Maps semantic k-NN neighborhoods into directed graphs to evaluate data utility. Reduces manual audit search space by 99.1% on HelpSteer2 and identifies thousands of hidden safety/factual preference inversions in HH-RLHF.

papers.title: propella-1: Multi-Property Document Annotation for LLM Data Curation at Scale
papers.abstract: Family of small multilingual LLMs (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B) that annotate text documents across 18 properties in six categories. Supports 57 languages, produces structured JSON annotations. Released propella-annotations covering 3B+ document annotations for FineWeb-2, FinePDFs, HPLT 3.0, and Nemotron-CC. Permissive commercial-use licenses.

papers.title: The Long-Term Effects of Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Introduces a long-horizon view of LLM data selection, evaluating selectors by future adaptation speed, forgetting, capability imbalance, and OOD robustness. Shows short-term selectors exhibit rank reversal. Proposes Long-Horizon Aware Selection (LHAS) objective with coverage, future-proxy transfer, and anti-concentration terms.

papers.title: MADS: Model-Aware Diverse Core Set Selection for Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract: Proposes Model-Aware Diverse Core Set Selection using neural activation states during LLM inference to distinguish data features. Core set selected by 3B LLM effectively fine-tunes 7B/8B/13B models. 15% of Alpaca-GPT4 dataset achieves 2.5% average improvement over full-data training.

papers.title: PODS: Beyond What to Select — A Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-Volume Scheduling for Efficient Model Training
papers.abstract: Reveals selection-induced regularization modulated by instantaneous selection ratio. PODS dynamically schedules how much data to select: alternates low-ratio regularization and high-ratio recovery phases. Reduces ImageNet-1k training cost by 50% and accelerates LLM instruction tuning by 2x+.

papers.title: Select2Reason: Efficient Instruction-Tuning Data Selection for Long-CoT Reasoning
papers.abstract: Novel instruction-tuning data selection framework for long-CoT reasoning. Uses difficulty-aware reward model and reasoning trace length heuristic. Fine-tuning on only 10% selected data achieves competitive or superior performance to full-data tuning on nine competition-level math benchmarks and four reasoning tasks. ACL 2026 Findings.

papers.title: Rethinking Data Selection: The Importance of Coverage over Difficulty in Generative Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Shows that selection methods for LLM fine-tuning have weak performance and random sampling often matches sophisticated methods. Proposes coverage-based selection using target model embeddings rather than pretrained embeddings, demonstrating coverage matters more than difficulty for generative fine-tuning.

papers.title: LLM-powered Coreset Selection for Time Series Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Proposes LEAP coreset selection method using pretrained LLM as external guidance for sample selection in time series incremental learning settings.

papers.title: Data-Efficient Large Language Model Training: A Survey
papers.abstract: Survey covering multi-dimensional data selection methods for LLM pretraining, including weighted coreset objectives and data efficiency techniques.

papers.title: When Data is the Algorithm: A Systematic Study and Curation of Preference Optimization Datasets
papers.abstract: Systematic analysis and curation of preference optimization datasets. Provides annotation pipeline and data curation recipes for filtering low-quality samples from preference data mixtures. ICLR 2026.

papers.title: Register Always Matters: Analysis of LLM Pretraining Data Through the Lens of Language Variation
papers.abstract: First study using registers/genres from corpus linguistics to curate pretraining datasets. Shows register of pretraining data substantially affects LLM performance. News register gives subpar performance; Opinion class (reviews, blogs) is highly beneficial. Combining well-performing registers leads to major improvements.

papers.title: What are they filtering out? An Experimental Benchmark of Filtering Strategies for Harm Reduction in Pretraining Datasets
papers.abstract: Benchmarks different data filtering strategies for harm reduction in pretraining datasets, evaluating their impact on LLM safety.

papers.title: Data preparation for large language models
papers.abstract: Comprehensive overview of data preparation techniques for LLM training, covering deduplication, quality filtering, and dataset composition with math-aware filtering for 14.7B tokens.

papers.title: Human+ AI: Large Scale Data Curation For Multilingual Guardrails
papers.abstract: Explores human+AI paradigm for large-scale multilingual data curation for guardrails, moving beyond LLM-as-a-Judge approach.

papers.title: The LLM Data Auditor: A Metric-Oriented Survey on Quality and Trustworthiness in Evaluating Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: Survey on using LLMs for data auditing, examining quality and trustworthiness metrics for evaluating synthetic data used in instruction tuning.

papers.title: Data Mixing for Large Language Models Pretraining: A Survey and Outlook
papers.abstract: Comprehensive survey of data mixing for LLM pretraining. Formalizes data mixture optimization as a bilevel problem on the probability simplex. Introduces a fine-grained taxonomy: static (rule-based, learning-based) vs dynamic (adaptive, externally guided) mixing. Analyzes performance-cost trade-offs, cross-domain transferability challenges, and unstandardized evaluation protocols.

papers.title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract: Reframes data mixing as a classical mixture experiment. Develops sparse second-order Scheffé response-surface models and constructs model-robust I-optimal designs for proxy data-mixing experiments. Shows domain value is strongly relational: weak domains become favorable through pairwise interactions with web text. Scheffé model preserves mixture rankings across scales.

papers.title: Always Learning, Always Mixing: Efficient and Simple Data Mixing All The Time (OP-Mix)
papers.abstract: OP-Mix (On-Policy Mix) unifies data mixing across the entire LM training lifecycle (pretraining, continual midtraining, continual instruction tuning). Key insight: candidate mixtures can be cheaply simulated by interpolating between LoRA adapters trained on the current model, eliminating proxy models. Improves pretraining perplexity by 6.3% and matches retraining performance in continual learning with 66-95% less compute.

papers.title: 20/20 Vision Language Models: A Prescription for Better VLMs through Data Curation Alone
authors: DatologyAI (Siddharth Joshi, Haoli Yin, et al.)
papers.abstract: Investigates how far data curation alone can push VLM performance, holding architecture, training recipe, and compute fixed. Applies a systematic curation pipeline to the MAmmoTH-VL single-image training data and demonstrates significant gains purely through data quality interventions.

papers.title: Uncovering Intrinsic Capabilities: A Paradigm for Data Curation in Vision-Language Models (CADC)
papers.abstract: Introduces Capability-Attributed Data Curation (CADC) for VLM instruction tuning. Discovers intrinsic capabilities from gradient-based learning trajectories in an unsupervised manner, attributes training data to capabilities via influence estimation, and curates capability-aware curricula through balanced selection and staged sequencing. Surpasses full-data training with only 5% of data.

tools_and_repos.title: MATES - Model-Aware Data Selection
tools_and_repos.description: Official implementation of MATES. Continuously adapts data influence model during pretraining. Open-source on C4.

tools_and_repos.title: DataComp-LM (DCLM)
tools_and_repos.description: Testbed for controlled dataset experiments. 240T token corpus, pretraining recipes, 53 evaluations. Based on OpenLM.

tools_and_repos.title: DeepCore - Coreset Selection Library
tools_and_repos.description: Comprehensive library implementing various coreset selection methods for deep learning.

tools_and_repos.title: Moderate-DS - Moderate Coreset Data Selection
tools_and_repos.description: Universal data selection using moderate coreset concept. Distance to class center as criterion.

tools_and_repos.title: QuRating
tools_and_repos.description: Multi-dimensional quality rating for data selection using LLM pairwise judgments.

tools_and_repos.title: RedPajama
tools_and_repos.description: Open dataset and processing pipeline for LLM pretraining. Quality filtering configurations for Common Crawl.

tools_and_repos.title: Datatrove (HuggingFace)
tools_and_repos.description: HuggingFace data processing library for large-scale curation. Filtering, deduplication, quality scoring. Used for FineWeb.

tools_and_repos.title: Dolma (AI2 Data Processing Toolkit)
tools_and_repos.description: AI2 data processing toolkit for OLMo. Modular components for filtering, deduplication, quality assessment.

tools_and_repos.title: Meta-Rater Scripts and Models
tools_and_repos.description: Multi-dimensional data selection with released scripts, data, and pretrained models.

tools_and_repos.title: DSIR (Data Selection with Information Retrieval)
tools_and_repos.description: Importance resampling with feature hashing. Baseline method referenced in DCLM, MATES, and many other papers.

tools_and_repos.title: MixMinMatch Datasets
tools_and_repos.description: Cross-source filtered datasets for Arabic, Turkish, Hindi. Demonstrates dedup as quality signal.

tools_and_repos.title: FineWeb / FineWeb-2
tools_and_repos.description: High-quality web dataset with documented filtering pipeline. FineWeb-2 multilingual extension.

tools_and_repos.name: Data-Juicer v1.6.0 (with Juicer model)
tools_and_repos.description: Data processing for and with foundation models. v1.6.0 (2026-09-08) introduces Juicer, a locally deployable data-refinement model that follows natural-language instructions for text cleaning, filtering, and semantic labeling. Also features cluster-aware partitioning, config validation, and LiteLLM backend support.
key_features: Juicer: natural-language instruction-based data refinement model (35B-A3B MoE)
200+ operators for text, image, audio, video, multimodal data
Image OHEM Selector for high-loss sample selection
Scalable: 70B samples in 2h on 50 Ray nodes

tools_and_repos.name: data-juicer-multimodal-curation
tools_and_repos.description: Multimodal training-data curation on Backblaze B2 using Data-Juicer recipes. Next.js + FastAPI app for authoring Data-Juicer operator chains (dedup, length/quality filters, resolution/aspect checks), running them locally, and streaming raw/refined datasets through B2's S3-compatible API. Dashboard with curation metrics.

tools_and_repos.name: DatasetForge
tools_and_repos.description: Synthetic dataset generation, curation, and deduplication toolkit for AI & LLM training workflows. Full pipeline: ingest → generate → dedupe → score → package → verify → registry. Supports row-level and embedding-based deduplication, quality scoring, and SQLite registry for dataset versioning.

tools_and_repos.name: curation-discipline
tools_and_repos.description: Claude Code plugin enforcing data curation discipline: staging gate that AI agents cannot bypass, read-only enforcement by hook rather than prompt. Five agents, three skills, two tested hooks, and a catalogue of silent data-pipeline failures. Addresses the problem of agents silently corrupting datasets.

tools_and_repos.name: awesome-vietnamese-llm-dataset
tools_and_repos.description: Curated list of Vietnamese-language datasets for the LLM era: pretraining, SFT, benchmarks. Useful as a language-specific dataset index.

tools_and_repos.name: Advanced-LLM-Framework-NON-MOE
tools_and_repos.description: Production-grade dense (non-MoE) LLM training pipeline: pretrain → SFT → GRPO/DPO. Includes data curation stages in the training workflow.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: A Survey of LLM x DATA (Tsinghua Technical Report)
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Detailed PDF survey covering full LLM data lifecycle. Tutorial-level coverage of data processing, storage, serving.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: DataComp-LM Benchmark Platform
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: DCLM benchmark website with methodology documentation, leaderboards, and tutorials for dataset design challenges.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: FineWeb Technical Blog Post
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: HuggingFace blog on FineWeb-2 multilingual curation. Details filtering pipeline, quality metrics, and processing decisions.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: The Data-Quality Illusion: Rethinking Classifier-Based Filtering
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Critical analysis challenging common assumptions about classifier-based quality filtering. Important counter-perspective.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Investigating Public Fine-tuning Datasets: Construction Perspective
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Detailed review of construction practices for public SFT datasets with practical recommendations.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Data-and Training-Efficient LLMs (UC Berkeley Thesis)
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: PhD thesis on data quality as key factor in LLM data. Discusses Multimodal Data Quality Classifier and scoring approaches.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Aleph-Alpha-GermanWeb: Model-based Curation Pipeline Tutorial
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Technical report on building German pretraining dataset with model-based filtering. Serves as practical curation pipeline tutorial.
